pending_commit.commit_message: touch_updater: stupdate updater now uses common rebind_driver() function. Previously this updater script had its own rebind implementation, probably because rebind_driver() used to not support binding a device which didn't successfuly bind on boot, e.g. because its firmware was corrupt. This now takes advantage of being able to specify the driver to (re)bind the device to. BUG=b:132830741 TEST=Tested no-update, normal update, and firmware corruption recovery with stupdate touch updater. All cases succeeded as expected. Verified by testing basic touch functionality, examining /var/log/messages, and querying the touch controller for its firmware version. Cq-Depend: chromium:1772378,chrome-internal:1762938 Change-Id: I88aa97bec59267132d7c37989129f39593127576 Signed-off-by: Matthew Blecker <matthewb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1789022 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean O'Brien <seobrien@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Switch to old encryption of VK for TPM1.2 We will have to switch some TPM1.2 device back to having the old encryption. This change does the switch for all the TPM1.2 cases, making room for different scheme in the future without creating too much complexity in the code. The migration is also included here. We don't have to spread migration over two releases because decryption flow understands both types of encryption. appfuse: Replace WatchFileDescriptor by FileDescriptorWatcher. This is preparation of the libchrome uprev. MessageLoopForIO::WatchFileDescriptor is removed in the next uprev, and the replacement is base::FileDescriptorWatcher. This CL replaces it. Because the previous implementation unconditionally watches "writable" state, it was busy loop. This CL fixes it by watching writable state only if it is necessary.
